name: com.midtrans.sdk.uikit.views.bca_klikbca.payment.KlikBcaPaymentActivity
description: When a user selects KlikBCA online banking payments in Midtrans UiKit checkout, this screen collects the bank login detail requested by the SDK and starts the payment.
disableEffect: Disabling it can prevent users from completing payments with KlikBCA online banking payments.
